parent.semantic_boundary: The Stage4 rows remain historically preserved; Stage5 additions do not retroactively assert exact semantics, proof, status, MSC, importance, or rights review for inherited rows.

record_schema.applies_to: every Claim_Catalog record whose origin_stage is Stage5

source_registry.rule: Every source_id in an accepted record resolves to one content-pinned registry row and the independent checker replays the exact source locator.

release_layout.claim_catalog_scope: Stage5 additions only; inherited Stage4 variants are conserved by registries and migration rather than copied into the claim-record schema.

5.0.v4_ancestry: bound exclusively through Docs/catalog/v5/V4_Import_Receipt_v5.json and Migration_v4_to_v5.json

5.1.parent_release_root_sha256: must equal the independently recomputed 5.0 release_root_sha256

manifest_contract.release_root_formula: sha256(canonical_json(sorted([{path,sha256,size_bytes}], key=path))) over exactly the seven non-manifest artifacts; manifest bytes, manifest counts, and per-artifact row_count are excluded

5.0.count_scope: distinct active atomic origin_stage=Stage5 and origin_release=5.0 records after duplicate removal

5.1.count_scope: new distinct active atomic origin_stage=Stage5 and origin_release=5.1 records; preserved 5.0 rows do not count again

count_predicates.theorem: origin_stage == Stage5 and origin_release == release and active and record_role == claim and atomicity == atomic and truth_apt == true and category == theorem and declaration_kind == theorem and current_claim_kind == theorem and material_status == proved; lemma/corollary/proposition records may exist but grant zero theorem-minimum credit
count_predicates.open_claim: origin_stage == Stage5 and origin_release == release and active and record_role == claim and atomicity == atomic and truth_apt == true and category == open_claim and declaration_kind == theorem and current_claim_kind in {conjecture,hypothesis,open_problem} and material_status in {open,partial,independent,disputed}
count_predicates.answer_placeholder_rule: a declaration whose exact formal shape is answer(sorry) is open_problem, never automatically conjecture
count_predicates.direct_prop_rule: a direct Prop-shaped source-open declaration may be conjecture unless the source or exact shape requires hypothesis or open_problem
count_predicates.excluded_pointer_rule: type_of% pointers and definition-only indirections never grant theorem or open quota
count_predicates.duplicate_rule: a duplicate, redirect, excluded item, source pointer, or nonclaim grants zero quota even if a declared count includes it

identity_policy.ordinal_rule: integer suffix of S5-CLM equals integer suffix of its canonical ATV
identity_policy.historical_mapping: Every one of the 3,484 inherited ATVs maps to S5-CLM with the same ordinal; its S4 mapping remains immutable.
identity_policy.new_mapping: Every Stage5 ATV receives exactly one S5-CLM mapping and no S4 mapping.
identity_policy.allocation: Each release appends a contiguous, non-reused ATV suffix beginning at 3485; 5.1 preserves the exact 5.0 prefix before appending.
identity_policy.other_namespaces: ATO and ATS are append-only and unique but need not share the ATV ordinal; ATF increments only for new-family verdicts and may be reused only after reviewed family matching.

migration_policy.inherited_s4_cardinality: exactly one S4 ID for each inherited historical ATV
migration_policy.new_s4_cardinality: zero S4 IDs for a Stage5 allocation
migration_policy.s5_atv_cardinality: exactly one S5 ID for every allocated ATV in the release registry and exactly one ATV for every S5 ID
migration_policy.legacy_alias_rule: All 3,262 THM aliases remain immutable historical THM -> ATV -> S4 -> S5 chains; current terminal resolution is separate and may be one-to-many.
migration_policy.folded_rule: All 76 folded occurrences remain visible even without THM aliases.
migration_policy.lifecycle_rule: The eight inherited redirects and four inherited splits are content-bound; redirects flatten, split has at least two terminal children, no default child, no evidence/status/proof inheritance, and the graph is acyclic.

exact_requirements: source revision and local asset bytes match the registry pin
member path exists exactly once and contains no path traversal
member/file SHA-256, UTF-8 byte range, line range, and raw-block SHA-256 replay
qualified declaration, formal declaration, formal type, and nonempty docstring are present in the exact source block
raw category and raw status map through this contract
AMS assignment, source category, status, rights, dedupe, frontier, and importance fields satisfy the record schema
source_acceptance_policy.truth_boundary: source_curated_machine_extracted and independent_machine_validated describe extraction quality, not an individual human proof or current-status review
source_acceptance_policy.proof_boundary: mathematical material_status and formal_proof_state are orthogonal; a source-solved declaration containing sorry may be status=proved with proof_state=statement_elaborated_with_placeholder or source_asserted_not_replayed, never kernel_checked_sorry_free

statement_and_hash_policy.canonical_json: UTF-8 json.dumps(value, ensure_ascii=False, sort_keys=True, separators=(',', ':')) with no trailing newline
statement_and_hash_policy.mathematical_statement_sha256: sha256(canonical_json(record.mathematical_statement after removing only its statement_sha256 field)); the resulting value must equal top-level statement_sha256
statement_and_hash_policy.formal_declaration_sha256: sha256(UTF-8 bytes of the exact formal_declaration string)
statement_and_hash_policy.formal_type_sha256: sha256(UTF-8 bytes of the exact formal_type string)
statement_and_hash_policy.formal_docstring_sha256: sha256(UTF-8 bytes of the exact formal_docstring string)
statement_and_hash_policy.flat_statement_projection: record.statement is byte/value-equivalent to record.mathematical_statement after removing only mathematical_statement.statement_sha256; both include component_extraction_status
statement_and_hash_policy.source_statement_sha256: the extractor-provided SHA-256 of the exact unelaborated source statement payload
statement_and_hash_policy.normalized_statement_sha256: sha256(canonical_json({module: record.module, namespace: record.namespace, source_statement_sha256: record.dedupe.source_statement_sha256}))
statement_and_hash_policy.flat_nested_alias_rule: The top-level source_id, qualified_name, locator, formal declaration/type/docstring fields must byte/value-equal formal_statement. The flat statement equals the explicitly defined projection of mathematical_statement; divergence fails.

noncredit_keys: same source_id plus Unicode-NFC whitespace-collapsed case-folded qualified_name
cross_source_review_keys: source_statement_sha256 plus module and namespace context
dedupe_policy.priority_rule: Within the same module and namespace context, when the same exact source statement occurs in source-open and source-solved categories, retain one semantic allocation with solved/proved current status; the open occurrence remains a noncredit source/status-history row.
dedupe_policy.context_rule: A short raw payload such as A n never deduplicates declarations across different modules or namespaces; source_statement_sha256 is always wrapped in the canonical module/namespace context before identity comparison.
dedupe_policy.hard_homonym_rule: Name equality never merges different formal types or exact scoped statements.
dedupe_policy.two_independent_implementations: The independent checker rebuilds the three noncredit keys without importing generator or extractor code.

status_policy.formal_conjectures_basis: formal-conjectures category asserted at the pinned commit
status_policy.conditional_rule: Proof of A implies B does not give B standalone proved status; implication proof, antecedent status, and consequent standalone status remain separate.

frontier_and_importance_policy.truthful_bulk_frontier_basis: formal-conjectures category asserted at the pinned commit

msc_coverage_policy.accepted_record_requirement: Every accepted record has at least one source-supplied or machine-crosswalked MSC class and exactly one primary top-level class.
msc_coverage_policy.coverage_ledger_requirement: Coverage_Ledger contains exactly one row for every listed top-level class with 5.0 theorem/open, 5.1 theorem, reserve, source, classification-basis, and scarcity counts or notes.
msc_coverage_policy.completion_claim: real observed coverage relative to pinned sources, not complete coverage of all MSC mathematics

candidate_disposition_field_contract.normalized_statement_sha256: sha256(canonical_json({module,namespace,source_statement_sha256})); the checker independently recovers module and namespace from the source record for this candidate
candidate_disposition_field_contract.reason_code: nonempty closed generator reason string retained verbatim by checker
candidate_disposition_field_contract.target_variant_id: ATV-######## for accepted_new_claim or already_allocated_noncredit; otherwise null except an explicitly reviewed existing-target disposition
candidate_disposition_field_contract.target_s5_id: S5-CLM-######## exactly paired with target_variant_id for accepted_new_claim or already_allocated_noncredit; otherwise null
candidate_disposition_field_contract.duplicate_of_variant_id: ATV-######## only for duplicate_noncredit, otherwise null
candidate_disposition_field_contract.grants_quota: true exactly for accepted_new_claim and false for every other disposition, including already_allocated_noncredit

msc_coverage_field_contract.msc_top_class: one of the exact 63 MSC2020 top-level codes; rows sorted numerically as strings and unique
msc_coverage_field_contract.current_theorem_s5_ids: sorted unique cumulative theorem projection IDs in this class
msc_coverage_field_contract.current_open_s5_ids: sorted unique cumulative open projection IDs in this class
msc_coverage_field_contract.origin_theorem_s5_ids: sorted unique theorem IDs whose origin_release equals this ledger release
msc_coverage_field_contract.origin_open_s5_ids: sorted unique open IDs whose origin_release equals this ledger release
msc_coverage_field_contract.open_reserve_candidate_keys: sorted unique noncredit reserve keys with no canonical or S5 allocation
msc_coverage_field_contract.source_ids: sorted unique registered source IDs contributing current or reserve rows
msc_coverage_field_contract.classification_basis_counts: closed object {source_annotation,machine_crosswalk,independent_review}; nonnegative integers whose sum equals distinct current plus reserve members after the ledger's one-primary-class rule
msc_coverage_field_contract.scarcity_reason: nonempty evidence-based explanation, including an honest zero/thin reason
msc_coverage_field_contract.counts: closed object {current_theorems,current_open,origin_theorems,origin_open,open_reserve}; each value is recomputed from the corresponding explicit array

coverage_ledger_contract.already_allocated_noncredit_rule: The target ATV/S5 pair must already exist in the parent or current release registry, must have equal ordinals, is not reallocated, and receives no release-origin or quota credit from this candidate row.

projection_policy.theorem_list: pure query using count_predicates.theorem over the cumulative Stage5 addition catalog visible in the release
projection_policy.open_claim_list: pure query using count_predicates.open_claim over the cumulative Stage5 addition catalog visible in the release

required_checks: record schema and exact unknown-field rejection
all source assets, revisions, members, file hashes, exact byte slices, declarations, docstrings, and statement hashes
5.0 and 5.1 origin predicates and minima from explicit unique ID sets
parent 1..3484 universe, append-only suffix, S5/ATV bijection and ordinal equality
3,262 THM alias, 76 folded occurrence, eight redirect and four split conservation
5.1 parent release root and immutable 5.0 bytes
dedupe priority, noncredit rows, source pointer exclusions, and answer(sorry) open_problem classification
all 63 MSC coverage rows with real zero/thin reporting
seven-artifact release root and every canonical document self-seal

mutation_requirements: drop, replace, or duplicate one inherited ATV or historical alias
renumber one inherited or new ATV/S5 pair
reuse an ATV tombstone or rebind an S4/THM historical target
make a split choose a default child or inherit evidence
alter a source archive, member path, file hash, byte range, raw block, declaration, formal type, or docstring
count one type_of% pointer or duplicate declaration
classify answer(sorry) as conjecture rather than open_problem
credit an open duplicate when the identical solved statement exists
claim kernel_checked_sorry_free for source_asserted or sorry-backed theorem text
remove one MSC row or replace a zero scarcity report with fabricated inventory
mark third-party source-specific terms globally Apache-2.0
change 5.0 after producing 5.1 or forge the parent root
spoof counts without changing explicit ID sets
change one non-manifest artifact without refreshing release_root_sha256

truth_boundary.inventory_completion: The release proves exact source-derived inventory thresholds and migration closure only.
not_claimed: all inherited Stage4 rows are semantically curated
every source-open label received independent current-status review
every source-solved theorem was replayed or is sorry-free
every importance/frontier label was individually ranked by a human
all third-party materials are independently rights-cleared
all MSC branches are represented or complete
truth_boundary.atomicity_meaning: atomic means one exact source declaration allocation unit for this import; it does not assert that every natural-language docstring is logically irreducible.

authority_hash_policy: sha256 over UTF-8 canonical JSON after removing only the top-level authority_sha256 field
